title: Gemini for Mac Can Now Use Your Computer for You
dek: Google's AI clicks, types and fills forms in its own background window.

facts.label: Sequoia or newer, Apple Silicon only
English only, AI Plus, Pro and Ultra plans

caption:
Your Mac just got a coworker that never gets tired of copy-and-paste. 🖱️

Google has added computer use to the Gemini app for Mac. Describe a multi-step job and Gemini will click, type, open menus and fill in forms across your local files, desktop apps and the web. It runs in its own background window with a live preview in chat, so your screen and cursor stay free.

Think pulling data from PDFs into shipping forms or turning dashboard numbers into a Google Slides deck. You pick which apps it can access, can pause it anytime and approve key actions first. It's rolling out to U.S. Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS Sequoia 15.0 or newer.

We're tracking the AI agent race daily at AI Parabellum. Would you let Gemini drive your Mac?

Gemini is no longer just a chat box on your Mac. Google's new computer use feature lets the AI operate apps like a person, in a separate window, while you keep working.

It's for paying U.S. users on Apple Silicon Macs for now, with app permissions, a pause button and approval steps built in.
